summary: Tested COC/CVO expanded feature (Honda exclusion, supplier metadata, admin tracking dashboard, dealer progress bar, status updates). 11/11 backend pytest tests PASSED. Admin /admin/coc-orders frontend dashboard verified with 2 real orders (Triumph via Mage Motos CHF 80 / €120; Yamaha via Hostettler €75), 4 status buttons per order, clicking 'Besteld bij leverancier' updated status successfully via PUT /api/orders/{id}/coc-status. Honda portal link present. Admin sidebar 'COC / CVO' link verified. Dealer /dealer/orders shows data-testid='coc-status-{orderId}' progress bars with 4 steps (Aangevraagd, Besteld, Ontvangen, Verzonden). React code review verified MotorcycleDetail.js: isHonda() gates honda-coc-info block (NO checkbox, with link), cocAvailable() gates coc-option checkbox for Yamaha/Kawasaki/KTM/Triumph only.

integration_issues.issue: Secondary request on dealer orders page returns 403 (visible in console as 'Failed to fetch orders: AxiosError'). Main orders fetch works fine - orders render correctly including COC progress bars. Likely a secondary call (archive or admin-only endpoint) being made unnecessarily. Low priority as page works.

action_items: Investigate the 403 AxiosError on /dealer/orders (likely secondary fetch to admin-only endpoint); not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/orders.py: GET /api/admin/coc-orders correctly excludes _id, enriches with motorcycle snapshot fallback. Good.
routers/orders.py create_buy_now_order: supplier email send is correctly wrapped in try/except (fire-and-forget). Good.
routers/orders.py update_coc_status: validates status against COC_STATUSES and needs_coc before updating. Good.
config.py: Honda correctly removed from COC_PRICES. COC_SUPPLIERS maps brands to correct supplier metadata.
MotorcycleDetail.js: isHonda() check for honda-coc-info block; cocAvailable() check for coc-option. Mutually exclusive for Honda (good).
CocOrders.js: data-testid naming consistent (coc-orders-title, coc-orders-dashboard, coc-order-{id}, coc-status-btn-{id}-{status}, honda-portal-link). Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin dashboard + dealer progress bar + status update click verified)
